subject: PTO-BSTART-TIMG2COL-CONTRACT-001
corroborated: IMG2COL expands output spatial positions into matrix rows and kernel/channel positions into matrix columns.
The channel-block storage quantum is 32 bytes and incomplete logical channels use padding lanes.
Source M/K crop coordinates are distinct from destination placement.
Matrix output is consumed in fixed CUBE tiles while physical tails remain outside the valid logical rectangle.
excluded_target_specific: target-specific alignment, warning, and zero-extent NOP behavior
